{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or low (e.g., < 0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive, to avoid lagged reactions.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment strongly supports upward trend.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp spikes (e.g., > 15% above prior peak) by 10-20% to avoid overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.00-0.33), use 30-day moving average as baseline, with ±5% volatility buffer.",
    "For high sentiment (0.67-1.0), allow 10-15% upward bias but cap at 20% above 30-day high to prevent runaway inflation.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., 3 consecutive days), reduce next forecast by 5-10% to avoid overestimation."
  ]
}
